verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs describe Prompt Management for versioning, storing, and deploying prompts, plus client SDKs that keep prompts in sync across applications and environments. This implies prompts can be fetched at runtime and changed without a code release. missing for 10: explicit docs on environment/production tagging or promotion of a prompt version, a concrete description of runtime prompt fetching that decouples deploys from code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
